mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CONTENT_SHARES s WHERE s.CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType} AND s.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' AND (s.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR s.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) AND ( (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND s.TARGET_ID = #{userId}) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS wm WHERE wm.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND wm.USER_ID = #{userId})) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND pm.USER_ID = #{userId})) )

SELECT OWNER_ID FROM ( SELECT n.USER_ID AS OWNER_ID FROM NOTES n WHERE #{contentType} = 'NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID = #{contentId} UNION ALL SELECT p.CREATED_BY AS OWNER_ID FROM PHOTO_POSTS p WHERE #{contentType} = 'PHOTO' AND p.POST_ID = #{contentId} ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT s.SHARE_ID, s.CONTENT_TYPE, s.CONTENT_ID, s.OWNER_ID, s.TARGET_TYPE, s.TARGET_ID, s.PERMISSION_TYPE, s.SHARED_BY, s.CREATED_AT, s.EXPIRES_AT, s.ACTIVE_YN, NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') AS SHARE_STATUS, s.RESPONDED_BY, s.RESPONDED_AT, CASE s.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'USER' THEN u.USER_NAME WHEN 'WS' THEN w.WS_NAME WHEN 'PROJ' THEN p.PROJ_NAME END AS TARGET_NAME, CASE s.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'USER' THEN u.EMAIL WHEN 'WS' THEN '워크스페이스' WHEN 'PROJ' THEN w2.WS_NAME END AS TARGET_SUBTEXT FROM CONTENT_SHARES s LEFT JOIN USERS u ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND u.USER_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES w ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND w.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN PROJECTS p ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND p.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES w2 ON p.WS_ID = w2.WS_ID WHERE s.CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType} AND s.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') AND (s.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR s.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT DESC, s.SHARE_ID DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO CONTENT_SHARES s USING ( SELECT #{contentType} CONTENT_TYPE, #{contentId} CONTENT_ID, #{targetType} TARGET_TYPE, #{targetId} TARGET_ID FROM DUAL ) x ON (s.CONTENT_TYPE = x.CONTENT_TYPE AND s.CONTENT_ID = x.CONTENT_ID AND s.TARGET_TYPE = x.TARGET_TYPE AND s.TARGET_ID = x.TARGET_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET s.PERMISSION_TYPE = #{permissionType}, s.SHARED_BY = #{sharedBy}, s.OWNER_ID = #{ownerId}, s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y', s.SHARE_STATUS = 'PENDING', s.RESPONDED_BY = NULL, s.RESPONDED_AT = NULL, s.EXPIRES_AT = #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, s.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SHARE_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, CONTENT_ID, OWNER_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, PERMISSION_TYPE, SHARED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, EXPIRES_AT, ACTIVE_YN, SHARE_STATUS, RESPONDED_BY, RESPONDED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONTENT_SHARE_ID.NEXTVAL, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{ownerId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{permissionType}, #{sharedBy}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'Y', 'PENDING', NULL, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT s.SHARE_ID, s.CONTENT_TYPE, s.CONTENT_ID, s.OWNER_ID, s.TARGET_TYPE, s.TARGET_ID, s.PERMISSION_TYPE, s.SHARED_BY, s.CREATED_AT, s.EXPIRES_AT, s.ACTIVE_YN, NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') AS SHARE_STATUS, s.RESPONDED_BY, s.RESPONDED_AT, CASE s.CONTENT_TYPE WHEN 'PHOTO' THEN NVL(pp.TITLE, '사진 게시물') WHEN 'NOTE' THEN NVL(n.NOTE_TITLE, '노트') ELSE s.CONTENT_TYPE END AS CONTENT_TITLE, ru.USER_NAME AS REQUESTER_NAME, ru.EMAIL AS REQUESTER_EMAIL, CASE s.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'USER' THEN tu.USER_NAME WHEN 'WS' THEN tw.WS_NAME WHEN 'PROJ' THEN tp.PROJ_NAME END AS TARGET_NAME, CASE s.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'USER' THEN tu.EMAIL WHEN 'WS' THEN '그룹' WHEN 'PROJ' THEN tw2.WS_NAME END AS TARGET_SUBTEXT FROM CONTENT_SHARES s LEFT JOIN PHOTO_POSTS pp ON s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'PHOTO' AND pp.POST_ID = s.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN NOTES n ON s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID = s.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN USERS ru ON ru.USER_ID = s.SHARED_BY LEFT JOIN USERS tu ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND tu.USER_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES tw ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND tw.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN PROJECTS tp ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND tp.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES tw2 ON tp.WS_ID = tw2.WS_ID WHERE s.SHARE_ID = #{shareId}
mapper.sql: SELECT s.SHARE_ID, s.CONTENT_TYPE, s.CONTENT_ID, s.OWNER_ID, s.TARGET_TYPE, s.TARGET_ID, s.PERMISSION_TYPE, s.SHARED_BY, s.CREATED_AT, s.EXPIRES_AT, s.ACTIVE_YN, NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') AS SHARE_STATUS, s.RESPONDED_BY, s.RESPONDED_AT, CASE s.CONTENT_TYPE WHEN 'PHOTO' THEN NVL(pp.TITLE, '사진 게시물') WHEN 'NOTE' THEN NVL(n.NOTE_TITLE, '노트') ELSE s.CONTENT_TYPE END AS CONTENT_TITLE, ru.USER_NAME AS REQUESTER_NAME, ru.EMAIL AS REQUESTER_EMAIL, CASE s.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'USER' THEN tu.USER_NAME WHEN 'WS' THEN tw.WS_NAME WHEN 'PROJ' THEN tp.PROJ_NAME END AS TARGET_NAME, CASE s.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'USER' THEN tu.EMAIL WHEN 'WS' THEN '그룹' WHEN 'PROJ' THEN tw2.WS_NAME END AS TARGET_SUBTEXT FROM CONTENT_SHARES s LEFT JOIN PHOTO_POSTS pp ON s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'PHOTO' AND pp.POST_ID = s.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN NOTES n ON s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID = s.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN USERS ru ON ru.USER_ID = s.SHARED_BY LEFT JOIN USERS tu ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND tu.USER_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES tw ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND tw.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN PROJECTS tp ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND tp.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES tw2 ON tp.WS_ID = tw2.WS_ID WHERE s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND (s.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR s.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE)
mapper.select: AND s.SHARED_BY = #{userId} ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT DESC, s.SHARE_ID DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CONTENT_SHARES s WHERE s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'PENDING' AND (s.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR s.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) AND ( (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND s.TARGET_ID = #{userId}) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES wown WHERE wown.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND wown.OWNER_ID = #{userId})) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS wm WHERE wm.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND wm.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(wm.WS_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) = 'ADMIN')) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr WHERE pr.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND pr.LEADER_ID = #{userId})) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND pm.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(pm.PROJ_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) IN ('ADMIN','LEADER','OWNER','PM'))) )

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CONTENT_SHARES s WHERE s.SHARE_ID = #{shareId} AND s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND ( (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND s.TARGET_ID = #{userId}) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES wown WHERE wown.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND wown.OWNER_ID = #{userId})) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS wm WHERE wm.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND wm.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(wm.WS_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) = 'ADMIN')) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr WHERE pr.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND pr.LEADER_ID = #{userId})) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND pm.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(pm.PROJ_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) IN ('ADMIN','LEADER','OWNER','PM'))) )
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_SHARES SET SHARE_STATUS = #{status}, RESPONDED_BY = #{userId}, RESPONDED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE SHARE_ID = #{shareId} AND ACTIVE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.USER_ID AS "targetId", NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL) AS "targetName", u.EMAIL AS "targetSubtext", u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH AS "profileImagePath" FROM USERS u WHERE u.USER_ID != #{userId} AND NVL(u.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_FRIENDS f WHERE f.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND ( (f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND f.ADDRESSEE_ID = u.USER_ID) OR (f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND f.REQUESTER_ID = u.USER_ID) ) )
AND (UPPER(NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(u.EMAIL) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%')
ORDER BY NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL), u.EMAIL ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 30

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_FRIENDS f WHERE f.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND ( (f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{friendUserId}) OR (f.REQUESTER_ID = #{friendUserId} AND f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId}) )

SELECT w.WS_ID AS "targetId", w.WS_NAME AS "targetName", '워크스페이스' AS "targetSubtext", w.WS_IMAGE_PATH AS "profileImagePath" FROM WORKSPACES w WHERE w.OWNER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS wm WHERE wm.WS_ID = w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID = #{userId}) ORDER BY w.WS_NAME

SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "targetId", p.PROJ_NAME AS "targetName", w.WS_NAME AS "targetSubtext", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(500)) AS "profileImagePath" FROM PROJECTS p JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = p.WS_ID WHERE p.LEADER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID = #{userId}) ORDER BY w.WS_NAME, p.PROJ_NAME
